relevance_note: Single case report of a man with a LAMP2 variant: "resulting in 1 plausible candidate variant that was located in LAMP2: NM_002294: c.877C>T p. (Arg293∗)".
method_note: Hand-built from a full read of the paper (no tables; a Python script only assembled the JSON). The proband is labelled 'patient' (rule 5; 'the proband' is a role word). The sibling who died suddenly at age 1 ('one of his siblings, a young girl') is included as 'sibling of patient' as a relative described in relation to the proband; she was not tested and her link to Danon disease is not stated. First-degree relatives with 'no known cardiomyopathy' are a group without individual detail and get no rows. A second variant in TNNI3K was attributed to the patient and recorded. Contradictions/oddities: the transcript is printed 'NM_0022294' in the Figure 2 legend but 'NM_002294' in the text (text form recorded); the TNNI3K variant p.(Glu65∗) is called a 'missense mutation' by the authors (recorded as stated) although its protein notation shows a stop; the paper says ClinVar 'variation ID: 163812' with reference 4, while reference 2 is the ClinVar URL. Ages: only the age at referral ('at the age of 24 years') is given; it is not recorded as age at last evaluation (follow-up continued at least 6 months after ICD placement) nor as age at diagnosis (not stated), so both are 'not reported'. Vital status of the proband is not stated explicitly. 'Eye retinal examination was normal' recorded as retinal abnormality excluded (D-27) and used to exclude the retinopathy checklist item. 'Preserved left ventricular ejection fraction (60%)' excludes reduced EF as a feature, but the composite checklist item 'dilated or hypokinetic left ventricle' is left not reported because dilation is not addressed. Heart failure is not stated as a diagnosis (only referral to heart failure experts), so not reported. Some features (restrictive filling, low e′ velocities) come from the Figure 1 legend.
